column2: Got {g}!
Got {g} yen!
There's nothing inside.

I am Juzo Kabuto, a scientist who builds robots. The Demon God I left behind as I died is something else! It can become a god and save mankind, or become a devil and destroy the world! The choice is yours! It will do whatever you wish! If you ever meet the Demon God's pilot, you'll have a mighty ally on your side!!

I am Juzo Kabuto, a scientist who builds robots. I hear that after my death, many robots were born. Among them, I hear, is one built on an energy found through space research: a magic light where a mere trace gives enormous power... Getter Rays! Wahahaha! I'd love to see it! Even dead, I can't get enough of robot building!!
Yes\nNo\n
Got an e-mail... What's this? "When the black moon shines, let us meet"... huh? What's that supposed to mean?
Oh no! I'm way late!
You're late, {p}!\n\nHonestly! Who do you think I am!?
Who... well...
You're {s}, right?
So you DO know! And still you keep me waiting this long! You're always so sloppy about time, {p}!
But you called me out of nowhere... I had plans too...
No excuses! I'm through with you!
Don't be mad!\n\nSo, what's this thing you wanted to talk about?
W-well, um... the thing is...
I've been keeping quiet about it, but...
Hey! Are you even listening!? Why are you looking at e-mail!?
N-no, it says... a black moon...
A black moon? What are you on about? The moon can't be black!
...Huh?
...Hey, what's THAT?
When the black moon shines, let us meet...
...What's that?
It's the e-mail I just got.
Look! The moon... The black moon is getting bigger!
An earthquake!\n\nWhoaaa!!
Kyaaa!
An earthquake!\n\nThe Dimension Chain is starting again!? No, that's impossible!!
Wh-where am I...? What on earth happened?
A-are you okay? {s}! Hang in there!
...Uhh... nnn...
Thank goodness! Looks like you've come to!
What happened to us?
I don't know. The moon went black... and then...
Hey, someone's lying there...!
...But there was nobody in the park but the two of us!
Anyway, we'd better see how they are...
Hey! Are you all right!?
...Uhh... nnn...
...I'm all right.
Sh-she's cute...
Hey! What are you blushing for!? Look, there's someone lying over there too!
Hey! Are you all right!?
...Uhh... nnn...
He's good-looking, but he seems kind of a pushover...
Sorry...
Oh, d-did you hear that!? I'm sorry...
It's fine. Did you two save us?
Well, I wouldn't really call it saving...
We don't know what's going on either!
I see.\n\nI'm Akira Fudo. And you two are...?
I'm Honey Kisaragi.
I'm {p}.
And I'm {s}. Nice to meet you!
...So, Akira-kun, you were on your way home from school?
I was heading back to the Makimuras', where I board. Miki-chan must be worried sick...
Miki-chan... your girlfriend? Lucky! Me, I'm at an all-girls boarding school.
No boyfriend?
It's nothing but girls around me...
Where were you, Honey?
I was meeting my roommate.\n\nIf we miss curfew, we're locked out of the dorm...
So you two were sneaking back into the dorm together?
Uh-huh.
Oh, sorry, one sec. Hello...?
{!R}Akira, I need you. Come to my house. Take the left path and you'll reach it.{!W}
Hold on! A-actually, I'm kind of in a bind here, you see...
{!R}My business is more important. Come.{!W}
Geez, that Ryo...\n\nMy best friend, Ryo Asuka, is calling for me. He's so pushy, it drives me nuts.
Oh, it's from Papa! Hello...?
{!R}Honey, come to me... Honey...{!W}
Papa! What's wrong!?
{!R}Honey, come to me... Honey...\n\nTake the right path and you should reach my laboratory. Honey, come to me... Honey...{!W}
It cut off... Did something happen...?
Oh, right! Look at this!
Let's see...
When the black moon shines, let us meet...?
Now that you mention it...!
I saw it too...!
What!?
You two saw the black moon...!?
Huh!?
What's wrong?
Only my phone has no signal...
Mine has no signal either...
Mine too...
No way! You both just got calls a second ago!
Anyway, one thing's clear... I have to take the right path, and Akira-kun has to take the left.
...You're going alone!?
Don't worry! We won't let you go alone!
Who knows what's out there...
Papa said to take the right path, but there was no place like this near the lab...
There was no place like this near Ryo's house, either!
So going it alone is dangerous... right.
Then here's the plan!
Akira-kun and Honey each have somewhere they have to go. So we split into Team Akira and Team Honey. Once we've done what we came for, we meet back here. How's that?
Sounds good!
I'm in!
So, {p}, who are you going with?
